question:
The below bar graph shows the number of toys sold by five different shops (i.e., A, B, C, D and E) in the first week and second week.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65928f8b4a2fa4ce75f5115c13fc41c608b3beb112f1156b2b52b9823f264cbb.png] 

Find the ratio of the total number of toys sold by shops A, B and C in the first week to the number of toys sold by shops C, D and E in the second week.
solution: **Calculation:** Total number of toys sold by shops A, B and C in the first week = 20 + 40 + 30 = 90 Total number of toys sold by shops C, D and E in the second week = 20 + 60 + 50 130 Ratio = 90 : 130 = 9 : 13
